messages.text: Palmer and Alexander-Arnold recalled to England squad

metadata.summary: Trent Alexander-Arnold and Cole Palmer have been recalled to the England squad by Thomas Tuchel for the upcoming Nations League games.
metadata.content: Trent Alexander-Arnold and Cole Palmer recalled to England squad for Nations League games by Thomas Tuchel | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Breaking Trent Alexander-Arnold and Cole Palmer recalled to England squad for Nations League games by Thomas Tuchel England boss Thomas Tuchel has made changes to his squad following the World Cup; Real Madrid's Trent Alexander-Arnold returns to the fold along with Chelsea's Cole Palmer; Reece James and Phil Foden are among the players to miss out Friday 18 September 2026 10:52, UK Image: Cole Palmer and Trent Alexander Arnold have been selected in Thomas Tuchel's latest England squad Trent Alexander-Arnold and Cole Palmer have been recalled to the England squad by Thomas Tuchel for the upcoming Nations League games. Real Madrid right-back Alexander-Arnold returns to the fold for the first time since June 2025 along with Chelsea's Palmer, who was another high-profile World Cup omission. Tuchel has made eight changes from the World Cup in his 27-man group for the three-week camp, during which England, third-place finishers in the summer, will play four Nations League fixtures against Spain, Croatia and Czech Republic. Liverpool's 18-year-old winger Rio Nguhoma , who impressed in England's World Cup warm-up fixtures, has also been called up along with uncapped Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott .
